Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. Can CEA or hostel subsidy be claimed for a third child if not claimed for first or second child? Elaborate the cases when CEA csn be claimed for a third child.  
No. CEA or hostel subsidy cannot be claimed for a third child even if the same was not claimed for the first or second child because CEA is admissible for the two eldest surviving children only.
